# LayerItem QML Type

An Item that provides access to its transformation matrix as a property.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Import Statement | `import Qt.labs.lottieqt.VectorImageHelpers` |

- [List of all members, including inherited members](qml-qt-labs-lottieqt-vectorimagehelpers-layeritem-members.md)

The [LayerItem](qml-qt-labs-lottieqt-vectorimagehelpers-layeritem.md) type maintains a `transformMatrix` property, which at any time will contain the combination of the item's own transform with all its ancestors' transforms. It is used in particular to support linked transforms in certain vector graphics formats. As any type in the `VectorImageHelpers` module, it is only intended to be used in code generated by [VectorImage](VectorImage) and related tools.
